HOW_LONG_A_PLAYER_MAY_BE_KEPT: NOT AVAILABLE FROM ESPN. ESPN's data model has no field for keeper duration or a consecutive-seasons clock. The only keeper fields ESPN stores are keeperCount, keeperCountFuture and keeperOrderType. The league's two-year clock is a house rule that ESPN cannot represent, so it can only come from the commissioner or the league's own spreadsheets.
